task: An epidemic is spreading through major cities, killing 5–10% of the population per month. Coordinate an immediate public-health response within your governance structure.

dispatches.responsibility: Draft the emergency epidemic-relief edict: declare quarantine zones in affected cities, authorize emergency funding, and mandate medical deployment
Review the drafted edict for feasibility, legal consistency, and completeness before promulgation
Serve as execution coordinator: transmit the approved edict to the relevant ministries and track implementation across cities
Release emergency funds and grain reserves, procure medicines, grant tax relief to affected households, and maintain registers of the sick and deceased
Mobilize the imperial medical bureau and regional physicians, standardize treatment and prevention protocols, and conduct state rites to calm public fear
Construct quarantine camps and isolation hospitals, ensure sanitation and clean water works, and organize safe burial of the dead
Enforce quarantine cordons, control city gates and travel routes, maintain public order, and escort medical supplies and personnel
